issues.reason: The oblique-object half stands — bare 'trade' is a non-specific mass/abstract noun, and the preposition-named oblique's object NP follows the ordinary NP rules ('a bare mass / domain / proper name stays a constant'), so (For sk_use_1 trade) is the licensed form and no sk_trade_1 witness may be minted; the 'asserted as an occurring event' half overstates, since the instruction set's own control / causative doctrine holds that a tenseless reified event 'asserts or denies nothing about occurrence'.

The atom is not false of the sentence's content — the villagers are the understood trading party by the same subject-control default the instruction set applies to purpose complements ('copy the controller's role in'); what is unlicensed is the reification itself, already covered by issue 0.

'outside' in 'outside merchants' is an attributive-only relational modifier — 'the merchant is outside' states a physical position the text never claims — so it fails the predication test and is never exposed as a modifier genus, exactly the 'assistant secretary' case that keeps its head genus only.

gaps_confirmed: a purpose/ground 'for'-PP whose object is an eventuality noun carrying its own comitative argument ('for trade with outside merchants'): the licensed (For <event> trade) oblique takes a bare constant object and offers no slot for the 'with' phrase, so the outside merchants cannot be carried at all
new_gaps: the implicit participant of a nominal purpose adjunct ('use coin for trade' — whose trade?) has no licensed carrier: the controller-copying rule is defined only for infinitival complements and control verbs, so a bare purpose noun cannot record its understood agent
defect_summary: For the confirmed modifier issue the compliant form is the head genus alone — (Inheritance outside_merchant merchant) with no (Inheritance outside_merchant outside). For the standing half of issue 0 the compliant form keeps the oblique object a bare constant, (For sk_use_1 trade), dropping sk_trade_1 and both of its Agent atoms — after which 'with outside merchants' has NO licensed form at all and must be left out with the gap recorded.
notes: The definite-plural group event plus its per-member distribution rule, and the strengths/confidences throughout, are correct. The reification was graceful improvisation reaching for the uncovered comitative, but it broke a rule that IS covered (bare oblique objects stay constants).
